Mr. Smith has incurred a 2% finance charge because he was not able to pay on time for his balance worth $150. If he plans to settle his balance today, how much will Mr. Smith pay?

First, we need to calculate the finance charge. The finance charge is 2% of the balance of $150. 

\[ \text{Finance Charge} = 150 \times \frac{2}{100} = 150 \times 0.02 = 3 \]

So, the finance charge is $3. 

Next, we add the finance charge to the original balance to find out the total amount Mr. Smith will pay.

\[ \text{Total Amount} = \text{Original Balance} + \text{Finance Charge} = 150 + 3 = 153 \]

Therefore, Mr. Smith will pay $153.

FINAL: 153
